name: Korea Investment Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: Operating through its diverse subsidiaries, Korea Investment Holdings Co., Ltd. delivers a broad spectrum of financial products and services. Its extensive offerings encompass securities, asset management, and savings bank operations, alongside brokerage, credit financing, venture capital, private equity fund (PEF) management, and trading activities. The company also actively participates in real estate trust ventures and provides specialized investment banking and hedge fund management solutions. Founded in 2003, this Seoul, South Korea-based firm was initially known as Dongwon Financial Holding Co., Ltd. before officially rebranding to Korea Investment Holdings Co., Ltd. in May 2005.
